findings.title: Task 12's frequency-row UI test can't pass: the key hint is one text '4/5/6', not three texts
findings.claim: The new w4Ui test asserts `for (const k of ['4','5','6']) expect(texts()).toContain(k)`. texts() is an array of whole canvas texts, and the station draws the key hint as a single PixelText ('3/4/5' today; Task 12 Step 4 says 'the frequency row as today, with the key hint `4/5/6`'). No canvas text equals '4', '5' or '6', so the test is red after a correct implementation. Its title also promises the weak mark, but nothing asserts it.
findings.evidence: plan L2292-L2296 (the test), plan L2362 (the hint `4/5/6`); src/renderer/src/ui/duel/WeaponsStation.tsx:L156 (`<PixelText text="3/4/5" .../>`, one text), L152 (FREQ_NAMES labels on the buttons), L154 (the weak mark carries data-ui-weak-freq); manualTorpedoUi.test.tsx:L28 (texts() = each canvas's data-text).
findings.why: A test that is red after a correct implementation, with no rule to fix it. That fails Task 12's gate.
findings.fix: Assert `expect(texts()).toContain('4/5/6')` and `expect(texts()).not.toContain('3/4/5')`. For the weak mark, assert `q('[data-ui-weak-freq]')!.dataset.uiWeakFreq` equals `FREQ_NAMES[2]` (import FREQ_NAMES, or hard-code its third label).

findings.title: Task 11's online session cases don't fit the rig they name: the scene stub has no trigger(), and there are no key samples
findings.claim: Case (1) calls `h.sceneOpts[0]!.requests!.trigger(true)`, but the hoisted `h.sceneOpts` type and the scene mock's `requests` type list only pew/aimLaser/torpHeading, so this fails tsc -b. Cases (1) and (3) speak of 'a sample with selectTo: 1' or 'gunFreqKeyTo: 0'. onlineDuelSession's rig has no key-sample stub: keys reach the real keyboard through `r.key('keydown', code)` on a fake window. So the cases can't be written as described, and executors will write them differently.
findings.evidence: plan L2106-L2111; tests/onlineDuelSession.test.ts:L56 and L70 (the requests type literals), L137 (`key(type, code)` dispatches window events), L37 (`helds()` reads the sent held frames).
findings.why: Task 11's tsc gate fails unless the executor widens the stub. The 'sample' wording invites a second harness or a guess.
findings.fix: State: add `trigger(held: boolean): void` to both requests type literals (L56 and L70). Write the cases as key events: `r.key('keydown','Digit2')` (and keyup) to select the autocannon, then Digit1 for the selection-only held change, Digit4 for laserFrequency 0, Digit3 for no laserFrequency. Read held frames from `c.helds().at(-1)`.
